name: huffmanenco
expr: enc = huffmanenco(sig, d); dec = huffmandeco(enc, d); rt_match = isequal(sig(:), dec(:));
comment: MATLAB huffmanenco/huffmandeco: encode/decode round-trip via dict from huffmandict. Bit codes are non-unique (Huffman tie-breaking can produce different but equally optimal trees), so encoded length depends on which optimal dict shape was produced. The INVARIANT under both engines is round-trip identity: dec must equal sig regardless of dict shape. We pin rt_match==1, length(dec), and the first/last decoded symbols. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship the Huffman codec in core; reports N/A.
